rule: This sealed declaration is immutable. The live ledger starts empty and is intentionally outside the protocol manifest. Every later access must be appended before access as a hash-chained event and the exact event-count, tail hash and ledger-file hash must be committed and pushed to the protected origin/main checkpoint before outcome access. A confirmatory run event additionally binds the exact input, gate-evidence, research-corpus and protocol-manifest hashes, run id and cutoff. Every post-seal verification compares local manifest files, ledger and checkpoint with origin/main; rollback therefore fails after any later checkpoint. Any later rule change loses confirmatory status and requires a new protocol and future test window.
